main_text.l: e nobis, Philomela, dedit, quæ Vere sereno
rata redis, durasque affers oblivia bruma,
ua cœli iuuenile decus, mundique iuuentam
le nouo testata, dies noctesque, sub umbra
modulans, Vernis late loca cantibus imples,
ro tristi Borea, & nigris Aquilone procellis.
Hæc ego dum tacitus meditor, seu Vespere sudo
um dulci conforte thori, charoque[?] sodali,
rbe procul, Valles in apertas Vespere puro
Egrediar, seu mane iugum superasse iuuabit
aluebeli Ambrosii, & summo super aggere collis
Purpureum trahere ore diem, Ventosque salubres:
Multiplica, Philomela, modos, rupe omnia cantu,
Obsurda Virides dumos & opaca Vireta:
Vos cople, Philomela, modis: numerosque bibente
Aure tuos avida, totum me argutula comple
Cantibus argutis, & multisono modulatu.
Si facias, hæc sunt (& res mea Vota sequetur)
Quæ gratus precor, & grato tibi carmine canto.
En age, Vive, precor, nobis per frondea Iura
Gofraga[?], Vive, precor, longos, Philomela per annos.
Orphea tu Sylvas ducentem, Amphiona rupes,
Argutumque Linum, Methymnaumque domate
Monstra maris, querulos animat dum pectore
nervos,
Longe praterea, tu nablia, naula, lyrasque
Argutas, Vna obscures: Veteriscq cicada
EVnomij, doctosq modos, seu quidquid in umbra
Arcades imparibus calamis cecinere per alta

page.notes: Several words are uncertain in the scan (marked [?]), notably "charoque", "Gofraga" and the initial letters where the long s and a decorative capital are hard to tell apart. Lines are kept as printed, with line breaks inside the paragraph; no stanza breaks are visible.
